$comment: Per-declaration assurance for Broiler.Fond. Product projects only: the platform-neutral kernel library and the Windows host executable. tests/Broiler.Fond.Kernel.Tests (the BCL-only verification runner and its reference codecs) and eng/ (CI scripts and the Python fixture generators) are not listed, so they are not covered. No source here is third-party-derived, so there are no spdxOverrides. HUMAN_REVIEW.md is the hand-written two-person release approval record and is left untouched; the per-unit record is written to HUMAN_REVIEW.units.md.
regenerateCommand: dotnet run --project Broiler.Code/src/Broiler.Code.Review.Cli -c Release -- assurance generate --root Broiler.Fond
